# Patient Administration System

> Hospital patient administration: admissions, appointments, waiting lists, reminders and patient notifications, with a patient portal. Rust server, SvelteKit UI, PostgreSQL, Keycloak. Pre-1.0, not production-ready, unaudited.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Overview, layout, quick start
- [Plan](plan.md): Research and reasoning
- [Tasks](tasks.md): The live work queue
- [Install](INSTALL.md): Run it locally

- [Non-functional requirements](spec/07-non-functional-requirements.md): NFR-n, each with its verifying test
- [Spec-driven development](agents/spec-driven-development.md): Spec, code and test change together
